summary: Re-tested the critical /reset-password red-screen bug from iteration_116. The missing `import { PasswordInput } from '@/components/ui-v2/PasswordInput'` was added to /app/frontend/src/pages/web/ResetPassword.jsx line 8. Confirmed the page now renders cleanly (no ReferenceError, no runtime overlay), both PasswordInput fields (data-testid=reset-password-input, reset-confirm-input) mount with functioning eye toggles (reset-password-input-toggle, reset-confirm-input-toggle: type flips password->text). Ran full E2E happy path against the live preview backend: logged in sam@funasia.net/Perfect$2008 (200), created throwaway user resettest_1784677383@test.io via POST /api/superadmin/users (200), fetched a single-use reset link via POST /api/superadmin/users/reset-link with send_email:false (200, returned reset_link + expires_in_minutes), navigated the browser to that URL, submitted NewPass$2026 through the UI, saw the 'Password updated' toast + redirect to /login, then verified POST /api/auth/login with the NEW password returns 200 and the OLD password returns 401. Zero JS pageerrors captured. The only console noise is the same benign /api/auth/me 401 identity probe already noted in iteration_116 (pre-existing, unrelated).

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_116's only outstanding bug (ReferenceError: PasswordInput is not defined on /reset-password) is fixed and verified end-to-end. Full flow: superadmin -> create user -> reset-link -> open link -> submit new password -> login with new password all pass. No new issues introduced.
rca of the issue: ResetPassword.jsx used <PasswordInput/> at two call sites but never imported the component, so React threw ReferenceError as soon as the render path hit an authenticated (token-bearing) branch. E1 added `import { PasswordInput } from '@/components/ui-v2/PasswordInput';` at the top of the file alongside the other UI imports. Verified by (a) navigating to /reset-password?token=... and confirming the form mounts with no runtime error and (b) running the full super-admin reset-link -> update password -> re-login flow successfully.
